regime_context: Detector shows a broad rotation (50% of themes eligible) with no one-narrative dominance. Oil & Gas Producers lead by a thin margin over Gold Miners, but the rotation radar says 'directional: false' — this is attention, not alpha. Given track_record dir_accuracy of 0.371 on 89 calls, directional conviction must stay very low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners closes the 0.088 margin and takes rank 1 from Oil & Gas Producers over the next two weeks; retire the watch if the margin stays above 0.05 or if either theme's trend-gate flips to ineligible before then.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The prevailing narrative is confirmed energy leadership. The trend-gate (the only validated leg) keeps XEG.TO eligible, durability_bar 0.56 is middling, breadth 0.429 is moderate, and crowding is absent (z=0.85, not crowded). This is a hold-until-the-gate-fails lean, not a momentum-chase.
evidence: eligible=true via absolute-trend gate (validated risk-control leg)
broad rotation (frac 0.5), one_narrative=false — no dominant-theme blowoff risk
theses.dissent: The leadership margin over Gold Miners is only 0.088 and rotation is 'directional: false'; with no one-narrative dominance, this 'leader' may be a statistical artifact of rank ordering. A mixed hurst tag means the uptrend is not clean.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its own 20-day simple moving average before October 30, 2026

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are the confirmed challenger, sitting just 0.088 behind the leader and also trend-gate eligible. Durability is lower (0.46) and breadth weaker (0.267), but the theme is not crowded and remains in the rotation's top tier. Mean-revert hurst tag argues against extrapolating strength, but the gate is still open.
evidence: rank 2, score 1.342, challenger in rotation radar
must respect hurst_tag 'mean-revert' — strength may not persist
theses.dissent: A mean-revert hurst tag directly undermines the trend-following premise; breadth 0.267 is the weakest of the top three themes, suggesting narrow leadership within the miners basket.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO gives back its entire October-to-date gain before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is crowded (crowding_z 1.17, crowded=true) and sits at rank 8 with a negative score, yet remains eligible=true. This is a cap-not-fade call: the crowding flag is a down-size caution, not a short. Negative momentum plus crowding means this theme offers poor marginal risk-adjusted exposure while the gate still technically holds it eligible.
evidence: crowded=true, crowding_z 1.17 — strongest crowding signal in ranks
eligible=true — still passing trend-gate despite weak momentum
breadth 0.7 — wide but not supportive at negative score
theses.dissent: Technology has the strongest breadth (0.7) and highest durability_bar (0.7) of any theme; the crowding flag may simply reflect a healthy broad uptrend that refuses to roll over. Underweighting the widest, most durable theme risks missing continuation.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO closes at a 20-day high before October 30, 2026 while its crowding_z drops below 0.5
